Do It For Me (Official)
“Do it for me!”
Luke Han, a gloomy and awkward virgin, suddenly finds himself back in his college days. But now he’s got one outrageous new power:
the moment he pleads for it, no woman can say no.
Surrounded by gorgeous women, his long-buried desires start to boil over, and nothing’s stopping him from indulging every last one.
